merge: Load assets/townfolk/manifest.json, then Object.assign(man.townfolk.generator.presets, harbor.presets) (Python: T['generator']['presets'].update(...)). After that tf.preset('dock_worker', rng) etc. work with the unchanged Townfolk / TownfolkSprite code (tools/townfolk_compose.js / .py). Every part and palette named here already exists in assets/townfolk; nothing new is rendered.

dock_worker.notes: crane signalman / stevedore: knit watch cap (or hard hat), hi-vis vest over a work top, overalls, rubber boots, work gloves. Stand at harbor_crane staffPoints / workPoints, harbor_warehouse workPoints; carries crates with carry_walk.

sailor.notes: navy pea coat / cream fisherman sweater, watch cap, sometimes a red scarf and a beard. Walk off ships at ferry_terminal boardPoints, sit at sailor_lodge seatPoints.

auctioneer.notes: quilted vest over a shirt, bright rubber apron, cap, rubber boots - stands at fish_auction staffPoints[0] (talk / wave anims while bidding; play assets/audio4 sfx_auction_bell at fxPoints.bell).

lighthouse_keeper.notes: older keeper in a cream aran sweater or navy duffle coat, scarf, glasses and a (long) beard - lighthouse staffPoints.

tourist.notes: visitors from other regions arriving by ferry: bright winter jackets, bucket hats / caps, backpacks (children and adults) or satchels (elders), sometimes glasses. Spawn them at ferry_terminal boardPoints (reverse order) and let them queue at harbor_market / seafood_restaurant customerPoints.

existingCharacters.captain: assets/villagers2 npc_captain (captain hat, white beard, navy pea coat) - use him as the ferry / trawler captain
existingCharacters.fisherman: assets/characters fisherman + assets/workers fisherman_b (old sailor) / fisherman_c - trawler crews
